# YesDrop — email approvals on autopilot

YesDrop is a web application for running approval workflows over email. You send an
approval request by email, set a deadline, and YesDrop chases the reply for you with
automatic reminders. Every response is tracked in a single dashboard. The person
approving decides in one click from their inbox — no account, no login, no app to install.

Website: https://www.yesdrop.online

## The problem it solves

Approvals stall because people forget to reply and the requester has to keep chasing.
YesDrop closes the loop automatically: it sends the request, reminds non-responders on a
schedule, enforces a deadline, and records every decision — so nothing sits open forever
and you stop sending "just checking in" emails.

## How it works (three steps)

1. Send by email. Add an approver, a title, and a deadline, then send. You can schedule
   it to go out later.
2. They decide in one click. The approver gets an email with Approve and Reject buttons
   and responds straight from their inbox — no account, no login.
3. Track and auto-remind. Status updates live in your dashboard, and reminders chase
   non-responders until they answer or the deadline passes.

## Key features

- Send approvals by email — the approver decides in one click from their inbox, with no
  account and nothing to install.
- Deadlines that enforce themselves — a request left unanswered is marked "ignored" when
  its respond-by date passes.
- Reminders on autopilot — schedule follow-ups and YesDrop nudges non-responders for you.
- One inbox for every approval — track status, history, attachments, and reminders for
  every request in a single dashboard.
- File attachments — attach a document (e.g. a PDF) so the approver has full context.
- Sign in with Google or with an email and password.

## Use cases

- Expense approvals — e.g. sign-off on a quarterly marketing budget by a CFO.
- Contract sign-off — e.g. renewing a vendor MSA reviewed by Legal.
- Hiring — e.g. approval to extend an offer at a proposed band.
- Custom go/no-go — e.g. final approval to publish a launch announcement.

## Pricing

Free to start. Send your first requests in minutes. No credit card required.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: How do I send an approval request by email?
A: Add your approver's email, a title, and a deadline, then send. YesDrop emails them
Approve and Reject buttons so they can decide in one click.

Q: Does my approver need a YesDrop account?
A: No. They get an email with Approve and Reject buttons and decide in one click — no
sign-up, no login.

Q: How do automatic approval reminders work?
A: You set a deadline, and YesDrop sends scheduled follow-up reminders to non-responders
until they reply or the deadline passes.

Q: What happens if nobody responds?
A: Reminders go out until the deadline. If it passes with no answer, the request is marked
ignored, so nothing stays open forever.

Q: Can I attach files?
A: Yes. Attach a document to any request so your approver has full context before deciding.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: You can start for free and send your first requests in minutes — no credit card required.
